senses.gloss:
धृष् I. €1 P. (धर्षति, धर्षित)
—1 To come together, be compact.
—2 To hurt or injure. ━II. €1 P., €10 U. (धर्षति, धर्षयति-ते)
—1 To offend, hurt, injure.
—2 To insult, treat with indignity.
—3 To assail, overcome, overpower, conquer, destroy.
—4 To dare to attack, challenge, defy. —5 To violate or outrage (as a woman).
━III. €5 P. (धृष्णोति, धृष्ट)
—1 To be bold or courageous; ते ह ब्राह्मणा न दधृषुः Bṛ. Up. 3. 1. 2.
—2 To be confident.
—3 To be proud or overbearing.
—4 To be impudent or impatient.
—5 To dare, venture (with inf.)
—6 To brave, challenge; प्रहस्तस्य पुरोमात्यान् जिहिंसुर्दधृषुस्तथा
 (वानराः) Bk. 14. 102.
—7 To insult, treat with contumely. ━IV. €10 Ā. (धर्षयते) To assail,
 attack, outrage.

धृष्ट p. p. [धृष्-क्त]
—1 Bold, courageous, confident.
—2 Impudent, rude, shameless, saucy, insolent; स्तुवञ्जिह्रेमि त्वां न
 खलु ननु धृष्टा मुखरता Śivamahimna 9; धृष्टः पार्श्वे वसति H. 2. 26.
—3 Forward, presumptuous.
—4 Profligate, abandoned.
—5 Cruel, unkind.

धृष्ट + .{@-ष्टा@} A disloyal woman.
.━{@Comp.@}: धृष्टकेतुः, धृष्टद्युम्नः, धृष्टधी, धृष्टमानिन्, धृष्टवादिन्

धृष्ट + .{@-ष्टः@} A faithless husband or lover; कृतागा अपि निःशङ्कस्तर्जितोऽपि
 न लज्जितः । दृष्टदोषोऽपि मिथ्यावाक् कथितो धृष्टनायकः S. D. 72.
धृष्ट + -केतुः N. of the son of धृष्टद्युम्न.

धृष्ट + -द्युम्नः N. of a son of Drupada and brother of Draupadī. [He
 with his father fought on the side
[]
 of the Pāṇḍavas, and for some days he acted as commander-in-chief of
 their forces. When Droṇa had killed Drupada after a hard struggle, Dhṛṣṭadyumna
 vowed that he would be revenged for the death of his father. And he was
 able to fulfil this vow on the morning of the 16th day of the battle,
 when he unfairly cut off the head of Droṇa (see Droṇa). He was afterwards
 surprised by Aṣvatthāman while lying asleep in the camp of the Pāṇḍavas,
 and was stamped to death.].
धृष्ट + -मानिन् a. having too high an opinion of oneself, presumptuous.

धृष्टि a. Ved. Bold; धृष्टिरसि Vāj. 1. 17. ━m. —1 A pair
 of tongs. ━f. Boldness, bravery.

धृष्णज् a.
—1 Bold, confident.
—2 Impudent, shameless.

धृष्णु a. [धृष्-क्नु]
—1 Bold, confident, courageous, valiant, powerful (in a good sense); विष्णुः
 सहिष्णुर्धृष्णुश्च स एनं पालयिष्यति Mb. 14. 72. 15; रामस्य रोचिष्णुमुखस्य
 धृष्णुः Bk. 1. 25.
—2 Shameless, impudent.
—3 Ved. Strong, powerful.
धृष्य a. To be attacked, assailable, conquerable; as in अधृष्य q. v.
